requirement: WordPress plugin: lists upcoming courses on the front page (next 2), a list page and a feed. A course is upcoming if its end date, or its start date when there is no end, is today or later. About 150 courses with nine meta rows each; the front page is the busiest page.

expected.what: The meta_query with three OR branches plus the meta_key sort makes WordPress join postmeta six times; the meta_key filter sits in WHERE, so the joins multiply (9^6 ≈ 530,000 combinations per course) — seconds per call, on every front-page view. Critical.
